items.text: Buying your own health coverage for 2027? On HealthCare.gov, enroll by Dec 15 for coverage starting Jan 1, and the enrollment window runs through Jan 15. Some states, including Virginia, run their own exchange, and dates there can differ. We can help you compare plans by doctors, prescriptions and total yearly cost. Licensed in VA, MD, GA, TX, MI, NC, SC, AL, LA, IN and WV. Call (571) 354-0146 or visit honorbrook-insurance.com.
